title: Find Companies Using a Technology or Hiring for a Role
summary: How go-to-market teams and their coding agents find companies that use a given technology, or are hiring for a given role, with Cargo and TheirStack: one company search with tech and job filters, a job search for the postings themselves, and a stack lookup for one domain. Commands, filters, returned fields and prices.
body_markdown:
**To find companies that use a technology or are hiring for a role, run Cargo’s` theirStack.searchCompanies` action with the technology slug in` fields.company_technology_slug_or` and the role in` jobFields.job_title_or` . Both filters go in one call, it costs 0.5 credits per company returned, and each company comes back with the technologies and job posts that qualified it.**


Use` theirStack.searchJobs` when you want the postings themselves, and` theirStack.searchTechnologies` to read the stack of one known company. These are the steps behind the[find-companies-using-tech](https://www.getcargo.ai/skills/find-companies-using-tech) skill for go-to-market lists.


## How much this gets used#


Cargo platform data, 90 days to Oct 16 2026:` theirStack.searchJobs` ran about 117,000 times and` theirStack.searchTechnologies` about 98,000 times.


What each action costs, from its credit definition:


Action Credits Charged on


` theirStack.searchCompanies` 0.5 each company returned


` theirStack.searchJobs` 0.5 each job returned


` theirStack.searchTechnologies` 0.5 each call that returns a stack


A search that returns nothing costs 0 credits. No TheirStack account is needed: unless you connect your own key, Cargo runs the search on its key and bills credits.


## Know where the technology data comes from#


TheirStack detects a company’s technologies from the technologies its job postings mention. That makes it strong for tools engineers and operators are hired to run (a warehouse, a CRM, a cloud) and blind to tools a company uses but never writes into a job ad. Each detection carries a` confidence` of` high` ,` medium` or` low` , plus` first_date_found` and` last_date_found` .


## Run it#


### 1. Install and sign in


shellscript


```text
npm   install   -g   @cargo-ai/cli
cargo-ai   login   --email   you@company.com                   # sends a code
cargo-ai   login   --email   you@company.com   --code   123456     # creates the account on first use


```


### 2. Companies using a technology and hiring for a role


US companies of 50 to 1,000 people that use Snowflake and posted a data engineer role in the last 60 days:


shellscript


```text
cargo-ai   orchestration   action   execute   \
--action   '{"kind":"connector","integrationSlug":"theirStack","actionSlug":"searchCompanies"}'   \
--data   '{
"fields": {
"company_technology_slug_or": ["snowflake"],
"company_country_code_or": ["US"],
"min_employee_count": 50,
"max_employee_count": 1000
},
"jobFields": {
"job_title_or": ["data engineer"],
"posted_at_max_age_days": 60
},
"limit": 10
}'   \
--wait-until-finished


```


Drop` jobFields` for “uses Snowflake” alone, or drop the technology filter for “is hiring data engineers” alone.` limit` defaults to 10 and goes up to 500; start at 10 (5 credits at most) and read the results before raising it.


The filters that matter most:


Filter Group Takes


` company_technology_slug_or` /` _and` /` _not`` fields` TheirStack technology slugs, lowercase (` snowflake` ,` hubspot` )


` company_country_code_or`` fields` ISO2 country codes, case sensitive (` US` ,` GB` ,` FR` )


` min_employee_count` ,` max_employee_count`` fields` numbers


` funding_stage_or` ,` min_funding_usd`` fields` funding filters


` job_title_or` /` job_title_not`` jobFields` natural-language title patterns, case-insensitive (full-text search)


` job_title_pattern_or`` jobFields` regex title patterns, case-insensitive


` posted_at_max_age_days`` jobFields` 0 is today only, 1 is today and yesterday, and so on


` job_country_code_or` ,` remote`` jobFields` where the job is


` confidence_or` ,` first_date_found_gte`` techFields` detection confidence and dates for the technology match


Unknown keys are not errors: a filter under the wrong name or group is dropped, and the search runs without it. If the results look unfiltered, check the spelling and the group against this table.


### 3. The job posts themselves


` searchJobs` returns postings rather than companies. Job filters go in` fields` , company filters in` companyFields` :


shellscript


```text
cargo-ai   orchestration   action   execute   \
--action   '{"kind":"connector","integrationSlug":"theirStack","actionSlug":"searchJobs"}'   \
--data   '{
"fields": {"job_title_or": ["revenue operations"], "posted_at_max_age_days": 30, "job_country_code_or": ["US"]},
"companyFields": {"company_technology_slug_or": ["hubspot"]},
"limit": 10
}'   \
--wait-until-finished


```


### 4. One company’s stack


` searchTechnologies` reads the stack of a company you already have:


shellscript


```text
cargo-ai   orchestration   action   execute   \
--action   '{"kind":"connector","integrationSlug":"theirStack","actionSlug":"searchTechnologies"}'   \
--data   '{"fields": {"company_domain": "acme.com"}, "limit": 50}'   \
--wait-until-finished


```


It costs 0.5 credits per call, however many technologies come back.


## What comes back#


Action Fields to read


` searchCompanies`` name` ,` domain` ,` linkedin_url` ,` country_code` ,` employee_count` ,` industry` ,` num_jobs` ,` technology_slugs` , and the evidence:` technologies_found\[\]` (` confidence` ,` first_date_found` ,` last_date_found` ) and` jobs_found\[\]`


` searchJobs`` job_title` ,` url` ,` date_posted` ,` company` ,` company_domain` ,` location` ,` remote` ,` seniority` ,` technology_slugs` ,` hiring_team\[\]` (` full_name` ,` role` ,` linkedin_url` )


` searchTechnologies` per technology:` technology.name` ,` technology.category` ,` confidence` ,` jobs` ,` jobs_last_30_days` ,` first_date_found` ,` last_date_found`


` hiring_team` lists the people named on a posting, with their` role` , when the source names any. It is the shortest path from a job post to the team that will run the tool.


## Caveats#


- **Hiring is a short signal.** A posting is evidence for weeks, not quarters. Keep` posted_at_max_age_days` tight and rerun on a schedule rather than working from an old pull.
- **A mention is not a contract.** “Experience with Snowflake” in one job ad can be a nice-to-have. Prefer` high` confidence and several jobs when the technology is the reason for the outreach.


To turn the companies into people,[find the buying committee](https://www.getcargo.ai/blog/find-the-buying-committee-at-a-target-account) at each domain, or search[leads by job title](https://www.getcargo.ai/blog/find-b2b-leads-by-job-title-company-and-keyword) across them.


## Frequently asked questions#


Run` theirStack.searchCompanies` with the technology’s slug in` fields.company_technology_slug_or` , for example` snowflake` . Each company returned costs 0.5 credits.


Yes. Put the technology in` fields` and the role in` jobFields` of the same` searchCompanies` call; only companies matching both come back.


From its job postings. A technology a company never mentions in a job ad is not detected, and each detection carries a confidence of high, medium or low.


No. Cargo runs the search on its own key and bills credits, unless you connect yours.
